_description: 問診題庫,共 18 題。axis_positioning 是六軸定位 12 題(A/B1/B2/C1/C2/D 各 2 題)。B 軸拆成 B1 外線投射/B2 禁區低位得分,C 軸拆成 C1 外圍防守/C2 禁區護框防守(2026-10 改版,理由見下方 _editable_fields)。body_measurements 是身材類數值題 6 題,給「3 位深度模板」的身體最貼合和原型體型分數用。已經移除原本的技能行為題(skill_behavior):技能的訓練優先序不再來自技能自評,改由六軸差距與目標球員推導(見 src/engine/skill_level.py),所以不需要再問。axis_positioning 與 body_measurements 都是 BARS(行為錨定評分量表,見 SPEC.md §5.1)的題目——問的是具體行為或頻率,不是自評能力高低;body_measurements 例外,是直接填數值。
_editable_fields: axis_positioning 每題的 prompt(題目文字)跟 anchors(1-5 每個分數對應的行為描述)可以照 BARS 精神修改用詞,但每題的 anchors 必須維持 1-5 五個完整的行為描述,不能只改數字不改文字,否則就違背了 BARS 的設計目的。axis_positioning 支援 "reverse_scored": true(見 engine/axis_position.py 的 score_axis_coordinates,分數會自動 6-score 反轉再平均),但目前這 12 題沒有一題用到——六軸改版時發現舊版 B/C 軸的題目問的其實是「站位/角色分配」而非「表現好壞」,改版後每題都直接問表現型描述,不再需要反轉。body_measurements 每題的 prompt/unit/min/max 可以依實際需求調整,但改的時候要小心:(1) id 一旦被其他地方引用就不要改;(2) body_measurements 的 field 全部六項(height_cm/wingspan_cm/weight_kg/standing_reach_cm/running_vertical_reach_cm/sprint_100m_seconds)都已經對應到 players.json 每個球員的 body 欄位,新增題目要維持這個對應關係。body_measurements 的 body_height/body_weight 標了 required:true——身高、體重是原型分類(engine/archetype.py 的體型分數)的必要輸入,其餘四題維持選填(見 engine/body_fit.py 的 missing_required_body_fields)。要新增題目就照現有的物件格式加進對應的陣列。

axis_positioning.prompt: When the defense traps you, what's your first reaction?

anchors.1: I freeze up completely and get stripped or turn it over
anchors.2: I barely squeeze the ball out, but usually lose my rhythm
anchors.3: I can get the pass out, but a bit slowly
anchors.4: I consistently find the open teammate
anchors.5: I read the trap coming and find the next open man ahead of time

axis_positioning.prompt: In a single game, about how many times do you drive off the dribble to score or set up a teammate?

anchors.1: 0 times -- I almost never dribble more than two steps
anchors.4: 6-9 times -- I'm one of the main initiators
anchors.5: 10+ times -- the team runs its offense through me

axis_positioning.prompt: When you get an open look from the perimeter, about how often do you knock it down?

anchors.1: Rarely goes in -- I usually look to pass instead
anchors.2: Goes in occasionally, but I'd often rather pass
anchors.3: About half the time, depends on my feel that day
anchors.4: Goes in most of the time -- it's a reliable weapon for me
anchors.5: Nearly automatic -- defenses specifically scramble to chase me off it

axis_positioning.prompt: How would you describe your confidence in the pull-up jumper off the dribble (mid-range or three)?

anchors.1: I almost never pull up for this shot
anchors.2: I attempt it occasionally, with a low success rate
anchors.3: Moderate -- I take it depending on the situation
anchors.4: It's a shot I trust -- I take it with confidence most of the time
anchors.5: It's my signature move -- teammates trust me to take it

axis_positioning.prompt: Backing a defender down with the ball, with them wedged between you and the rim, what portion of the time can you score directly off footwork or a post move?

anchors.2: I attempt it occasionally, with a low success rate
anchors.4: I can usually create a good look with footwork or a pivot
anchors.5: I create a high-percentage shot almost every time

axis_positioning.prompt: How confident are you finishing at short range (from the rim out to the free-throw line)?

anchors.1: I rarely get the chance, or can't convert when I do
anchors.2: I occasionally finish, but often get blocked or miss
anchors.3: About half the time, depending on the matchup
anchors.4: I finish most of the time -- my touch is reliable there
anchors.5: It's an automatic scoring zone for me -- defenses specifically worry about it

axis_positioning.prompt: When guarding a perimeter ball-handler, what portion of the time can you stay glued to them for the full possession without losing contact?

anchors.1: I can barely hold on -- they create separation immediately
anchors.3: I can keep up about half the time
anchors.4: I can keep up most of the time
anchors.5: I can stay locked on for almost the whole possession

axis_positioning.prompt: After switching onto a perimeter shooter, what portion of the time can you prevent them from getting an easy open look?

anchors.1: They almost always get separation easily
anchors.4: I can contain them most of the time
anchors.5: I can contain them almost every time -- they struggle to get a shot off

axis_positioning.prompt: On defense, how often does the coach assign you to help-defend, box out, or protect the paint?
When you step in to help or contest a direct rim attack, what portion of the time do you actually disrupt or alter the shot?

anchors.1: I rarely help -- I'm usually a step late or pick up a foul
anchors.2: I disrupt it occasionally, but inconsistently
anchors.4: I create an effective contest or block most of the time
anchors.5: I'm a wall at the rim -- opponents actively avoid that side

axis_positioning.prompt: On fast breaks, how often are you the first one down the floor to finish (layup / dunk)?

anchors.5: Almost always the first one down the floor

axis_positioning.prompt: In a single game, about how many times can you elevate high enough to finish a put-back dunk or a block?

anchors.1: 0 times -- I can barely get above my opponent
anchors.5: 6+ times -- it's one of my regular weapons

body_measurements.prompt: Wingspan (fingertip-to-fingertip with both arms fully extended)
Standing reach (feet flat on the ground, highest point one hand can reach)
Running vertical reach (highest point one hand can touch off a running jump)
